testCase:
S-08: The variant you asked for is sold out
Goal: Add a Nimbra Trek Rain Jacket for Men in Forest, size L, to my cart.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/s-08/
STEP 2: Open "Nimbra Trek Rain Jacket for Men"
STEP 3: Choose the colour "Forest" and the size "L"
STEP 4: Click "Add to cart"
STEP 5: Verify "Added to cart: 1 × Nimbra Trek Rain Jacket for Men (Forest, L)" is visible

args.text: Nimbra Trek Rain Jacket for Men

steps.note: Attempt the requested addition; a disabled control must not count as success.

args.text: Added to cart: 1 × Nimbra Trek Rain Jacket for Men (Forest, L)

steps.note: Verify the exact requested variant was added.

reasoning: This tests whether the exact Forest, size L variant can be added to the cart and produces the requested confirmation. The plan preserves the positive assertion, so a sold-out refusal will fail rather than be reported as a successful addition.
